videos.description:
Watch the full movie WHEN ANGELS FALL, starring Richard Grieco & Julie McCullough.

When Hollywood turns its back on you… sometimes Heaven steps in.

She was Tinseltown's darling, until a controversy on a TV show got her fired and cast out. Now Lexi Thompson lives quietly on her boat, Serenity, in Apalachicola, Florida. She bakes at a local café and drifts the Gulf Coast waters, still haunted by everything she lost.

Then one evening, a mysterious man named Ariel steps aboard. Over the weeks that follow, he helps her face her past, find closure, and remember who she really is. Slowly, Lexi realizes Ariel is no ordinary man. He's an angel, sent to help her heal.

Inspired by true events, WHEN ANGELS FALL is a story of second chances, forgiveness, and the faith it takes to start over.

videos.description:

When he arrived at the city gate, he met the widow and asked for some water and bread. 🙏🏻🍞💧 The widow told him that she only has a handful of flour and a little oil. But Elijah encouraged her not to be afraid, and she did. From then on, her jar of flour and jug of oil never ran empty. 🏺

This story reminds us that when we trust and obey God, He is faithful to provide for our needs. 🙌🏻

videos.description:
Christine Pascal has one semester left and one plan: graduate, get out, and put distance between herself and a family she is tired of carrying. Then her mother has a stroke, and everything she was running toward stops being an option.

What follows is not a clean recovery story. Christine pulls inward, gets sharper with the people closest to her, and runs out of room to avoid the question she has been dodging: whether to stay closed off, or to bet on something larger than herself. The title is not accidental. Blaise Pascal argued that since we all lose eventually, the only rational move is to bet on something we can actually win. Christine has to decide whether she agrees.

videos.description:
Friends, do you want to get closer to God and know more about God? You are invited to join our group, and we will share God’s words with you, so you can draw near to God. Contact us via WhatsApp: https://shurl.me/ENSPWhatsApp

Christian Movie | "Where Is My Home" | Heartwarming and Touching Family Movie (Full Movie)

Wenya's parents separated when she was two, and after that she lived with her father and stepmother. Her stepmother couldn't stand her and was always arguing with her father. He had little choice—he had to send Wenya to her mother's house, but her mother was fully focused on running her business and didn't have any time to take care of Wenya, so she was often shuttled off to her relatives' and friends' homes to be fostered. After so many years of a life of foster care, young Wenya felt lonely and helpless, and longed for the warmth of a home. Only when her father and stepmother divorced did she return to her father's side, and from then on had a home, for better or for worse.
Once Wenya grew up, she was very sensible and obedient, and she studied hard. But just as she was working hard to prepare for her college entrance examinations, misfortune came upon her: Her mother had a brain hemorrhage and became paralyzed and bedridden. Her stepfather abandoned her mother and even took control over all of her assets, and then her father was hospitalized with liver cancer…. Wenya could not possibly take on the burden of the household, so all she could do was plead with relatives and friends, but she was turned down. …
Just as Wenya was suffering and without recourse, two sisters from The Church of Almighty God testified to Wenya, her mother and sister about the work of Almighty God in the last days. They came to understand the root of pain in people's lives from the words of Almighty God, and understood that only if people come in front of God can they gain God's protection and live in happiness. Only through the comfort of God's words were mother and daughters able to come out from their pain and helplessness. Wenya genuinely experienced the love and mercy of God; she finally felt the warmth of a home, and came into a true home. …

videos.description:

“This is the best depiction of the arrest I’ve ever seen!” - Forrest F.

“This is so powerful… I am in tears… Dallas.” - Shelia A.

“What a superb livestream, Dallas! Thank you! I appreciate the interview with Jonathan!” - sanjaypaul

The moment you’ve been waiting for came ONE DAY EARLY.

The day before Season 6 launched on Prime Video, we watched EPISODE ONE LIVE with fans around the world.

We premiered the full first episode, plus:

- Special guest Jonathan Roumie as he reflected on this crucifixion season and completing series filming
- Q&A with Dallas post-episode—if you had questions about the “beings” from the teaser vid we posted on social, trust us, you probably had even more after seeing Episode 1. Dallas answered.

The premiere episode was removed, but can be watched on Prime Video now.

New Season Prophetic Prayers and Declarations (NSPPD) is a global online prayer movement founded by Pastor Jerry Eze at the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020. Born at a time when the world was gripped by fear, uncertainty and despair, NSPPD emerged as a divine platform to counter fear, strengthen faith, restore hope and unite believers across nations in fervent prayer.

What began as a response to a global crisis has grown into a remarkable international prayer movement, bringing together millions of people daily across continents, cultures, denominations and generations.

NSPPD's influence has transcended geographical and religious boundaries, attracting international media attention and recognition from prominent global news organisations, including CNN, BBC and Business Insider.

Its digital footprint is equally remarkable. Pastor Jerry Eze's YouTube ministry has consistently featured among the world's most influential and widely viewed Christian ministry platforms, reflecting the extraordinary global appetite for the NSPPD prayer experience.

These landmark gatherings represent more than large crowds or impressive venues. They reflect a global hunger for God, a generation united in faith and the undeniable power of collective prayer.

Today, NSPPD continues to connect people across nations, inspire faith, ignite spiritual revival and create a platform where people bring their needs before God and share testimonies of His supernatural intervention.

videos.title: JESUS OOOOOOOO || VICTORIA ORENZE
videos.description:
The first song on the album is “Jesus oohhhh”

In Nigeria, there is an expression we make when we are overwhelmed by something: “Jesus oooooooo!” and that is exactly the spirit of this song. It is an exclamation of wonder, gratitude, and amazement at what Jesus has done.

“Jesus Oh” is a strong declaration of the transforming power of God. It is a song of thanksgiving and reflection that invites you to look at your past, look at your journey, and recognize that you are not the same person you used to be.
You are not where you used to be.

He has transformed your life. He has changed your story. And the beautiful thing is that He does not stop halfway. The God who begins a work is faithful to complete it.

The song is almost like standing on a rooftop and declaring to everyone, “Look at what He has done! He has changed my story. He has changed my life, and He can do the same for you.”
It is a celebration of the transforming power of Jesus and a reminder that when God begins with you, He takes you all the way.

videos.title: What They Won't Tell You About Late Marriage | Kingsley Okonkwo
videos.description:
What They Won't Tell You About Late Marriage
Late marriage, waiting for marriage, Christian dating, relationship advice, marriage preparation, and finding the right spouse can come with pressures and realities that many people rarely talk about.
What happens when marriage does not happen at the age or season you expected? For many singles, waiting longer for marriage can bring questions, pressure from family and society, comparison, loneliness, fear, and even the temptation to make relationship decisions simply because time seems to be running out.
In What They Won't Tell You About Late Marriage, this teaching addresses the realities of marrying later in life and provides practical wisdom for navigating the waiting season without allowing pressure to push you into the wrong relationship.
You will discover:

• The realities people rarely discuss about marrying later
• How age and societal expectations can affect relationship decisions
• Why desperation can lead to choosing the wrong partner
• How to handle pressure when people around you are getting married
• Why being unmarried does not mean your life is behind schedule
• The importance of preparing yourself while waiting
• How to approach dating and marriage with wisdom rather than fear
• Why choosing well matters more than simply marrying quickly

• How faith, purpose, maturity, and personal growth should shape your waiting season
Marriage is an important decision, but pressure should never become the reason you choose a spouse. The goal is not simply to get married. It is to build a healthy, purposeful and lasting marriage with the right person.
Whether you are single, dating, approaching marriage later than you expected, or supporting someone in their waiting season, this conversation offers perspective and encouragement for navigating the journey wisely.
Watch until the end and share this with someone who may be feeling pressured about their relationship or marital timeline.
—-

videos.title: Why Your Life Is Not Changing (And How to Finally Break Through) | Dr. Sam Adeyemi
videos.description:
Why is your life not changing despite your desire to succeed? What if the biggest obstacle to your next level isn't your circumstances, but the way you've been programmed to think?

In this powerful and insightful conversation, Pastor Kingsley Okonkwo sits down with his longtime mentor, Dr. Sam Adeyemi, renowned leadership expert, author, and Senior Pastor of Daystar Christian Centre, to discuss the principles behind personal transformation, success, leadership, and lasting change.

Drawing from his latest book, SHIFTS: Six Steps to Transform Your Mindset and Elevate Your Leadership, Dr. Sam Adeyemi reveals why many people remain stuck despite their efforts, how our subconscious beliefs shape our reality, and the practical steps anyone can take to experience a genuine breakthrough.

From setting life-changing goals and overcoming limiting beliefs to reinventing yourself for greater success, this conversation challenges everything you thought you knew about personal growth.

In this episode, you'll discover:

Why your life may not be changing despite your efforts.

How to reprogram your mind for success and lasting transformation.

The six steps to transforming your mindset and elevating your leadership.

Why setting clear goals and deadlines is essential for success.

How your habits and subconscious beliefs influence your future.

Why you may need to let go of your old identity to experience a new level of success.

How to navigate loneliness, criticism, and misunderstanding as a leader.

The importance of mentorship, personal development, and intentional learning.

How to discover and maximise your unique gifts in an AI-driven world.

Why Africa continues to struggle with development and what must change.

The role Africans in the diaspora can play in transforming the continent.

One of the most powerful lessons from this conversation is that lasting transformation begins from within. Before your circumstances change, something must change in the way you see, think, believe, and act.

Whether you're an entrepreneur, professional, leader, student, or simply someone seeking a breakthrough in life, this episode will equip you with valuable insights to move beyond limitations and take responsibility for your next level.

Get Dr. Sam Adeyemi's book, SHIFTS: Six Steps to Transform Your Mindset and Elevate Your Leadership, available on Amazon and wherever books are sold.

Watch until the end, and share this conversation with someone who needs encouragement to take the next step in life.

JOIN THE CONVERSATION: What is one mindset, habit, or belief you need to change to experience your next level? Share your thoughts in the comments.

Don't forget to LIKE, SHARE, SUBSCRIBE, and turn on notifications for more life-changing conversations on faith, relationships, leadership, and personal growth.

#SamAdeyemi #KingsleyOkonkwo #MindsetTransformation #PersonalDevelopment #SuccessMindset #Leadership #DaystarChristianCentre #PersonalGrowth

When you prioritize these mindset shifts, you position yourself to handle challenges with wisdom. This discussion is for anyone ready to stop looking outward for validation and start doing the work required for significant life improvements.

videos.description:
What happens when a bunch of Chosen fans come together to make an album? Listen to find out for yourself. Songs Inspired By The Chosen: Seasons 1-5 is now available wherever you get your music—https://chosen.lnk.to/InspiredBy1-5ID

---

A Personal Note from Jac Ross:

“I believe one of the greatest revelations in life is discovering that even when we are not pursuing God, His goodness is still pursuing us. That is the heart behind my song Follow Me. In The Chosen, when Jesus calls Matthew, He sees beyond the man the world has judged and recognizes the man grace can transform. What makes that moment so profound is that Jesus doesn’t ask Matthew to explain his past or prove his worth. He simply invites him into a different future. I believe that is the mystery and beauty of God’s love. He meets us in the very places where we feel most lost, not to remind us of who we were, but to reveal who we were created to be. Follow Me is my reflection on that truth. Sometimes the greatest act of faith is not having every answer, but trusting the One who calls us. And perhaps the most beautiful discovery of all is realizing that the God we’ve spent our lives searching for has been lovingly reaching for us all along.”

---

The morning after Jesus died and was laid in the tomb, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb to properly prepare Jesus’s body for burial. She quickly returned to where the disciples were staying to tell them that she had met with Jesus and that He had risen from the grave. The disciples were all gathered in a house in which they had locked all the doors because they were afraid of what the Jews would do to them when they found out that Jesus’s body was missing. Suddenly, a man appeared with them in the room. He said, “Peace be with you,” and then showed them all the wounds on His hands and His side. They all realized that it was Jesus, and they were overjoyed! Thomas was the only disciple who was not present when Jesus appeared in the disciples’ house. When the disciples told Thomas what they had experienced, Thomas told them that unless he is able to put his hands in Jesus’s wounds, He would never believe. Eight days later, the disciples had gathered in the locked house again when Jesus appeared in the room. Jesus told Thomas to touch His wounds. Thomas did as Jesus told him, and he exclaimed, “My Lord and my God!” Jesus said that while Thomas believed because he was able to see, “Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.” The chapter closes out saying that Jesus performed many more signs and wonders than are recorded in the book of John, but the ones that are included were written so that we would believe that Jesus is the Son of God and that, through our faith, we can have everlasting life. A Personal Note from Madison Ryann Ward:

“Writing 'Open The Well' gave me the opportunity to narrate how the exchange might have felt between Jesus and the Samaritan woman we read about in Scripture. Like other Bible characters we relate to, sometimes we see ourselves in that person in Scripture. The story of the woman at the well, however, is the deep calling to deep for my own soul. I may not have had five husbands, but I am still that woman with a past, overcome by love at the realization that I’m fully known and cherished anyway. Something about the story that captured my heart as I wrote this song is how before the encounter, Jesus was a stranger to the woman but never the other way around. Despite this, He revealed Himself to her and accompanied it with encouragement in who she was by acknowledging her. And, that’s a comfort that I also have in Christ. He wants to draw near to me even if or when I might choose to hide or retreat. The beauty of the woman being spoken to directly by Jesus also highlights the value God places on every woman across the world today — no matter her story or status. videos.title: What Future Are You Choosing: God's Approval or the World's Applause? - Dr. Arome Osayi
videos.description:
What kind of future are you building? Is your greatest ambition to acquire wealth, enjoy comfort, gain recognition, and impress people, or is your deepest desire to live in a way that pleases God?

In this challenging teaching, Apostle Arome Osayi calls believers to examine their priorities, guard their convictions, and refuse to exchange their fellowship with Jesus for the temporary rewards of this world.

**DECIDE WHAT YOU WANT YOUR FUTURE TO LOOK LIKE**

Apostle Arome Osayi presents a sobering picture of someone who has acquired a mansion and financial success but has lost the joy of fellowship with Jesus. Outwardly, such a person may appear successful, yet inwardly, there may be a deep sense of spiritual loss.

This message challenges you to consider what success really means. Financial stability and material possessions are not necessarily wrong, but they cannot replace your relationship with God. Before pursuing a particular future, ask yourself what it will require of your convictions, your character, and your spiritual life.

Would you rather have the approval of people while drifting away from God, or remain faithful to Him even if your life does not impress the world?

**NOAH: RIGHTEOUSNESS IN A DARK GENERATION**

In Genesis 6:9, Noah is described as a righteous man who walked with God in his generation. While the world around him was marked by corruption, his life stood out as an example of faithfulness.

Apostle Arome Osayi uses Noah's example to challenge believers not to allow the darkness of their time to determine the condition of their hearts.

You may not be able to change everyone around you. You may not be able to control the values of your generation or the decisions of the people in your community. But you can decide whether you will allow those influences to compromise your relationship with God.

Remaining faithful does not mean withdrawing from society. It means living with convictions that remain rooted in God's Word, even when those convictions are unpopular.

**THE SUBTLE DANGERS THAT DISTRACT YOU FROM YOUR DESTINY**

Not every distraction appears dangerous at first. Sometimes, the desire to have fun, gain acceptance, maintain an image, or belong to an admired social circle gradually becomes more important than spiritual growth.

Apostle Arome Osayi warns that believers can become so occupied with these pursuits that they neglect the deeper questions of their destiny and calling.

Entertainment, achievement, and social recognition are not automatically wrong. The danger comes when they begin to control your priorities, weaken your convictions, or draw your heart away from Jesus.

This is why believers must regularly examine their lives. What is receiving the greatest portion of your attention? What influences your decisions? Are your present pursuits helping you fulfil God's purpose, or are they making you comfortable with spiritual compromise?

**DO NOT SURRENDER YOUR CONVICTIONS**

The message carries a call to spiritual awakening. Apostle Arome Osayi expresses his hope that someone will hear the warning, rise from a place of spiritual compromise, and refuse to retreat or surrender to sin.

That decision begins with a willingness to recognise what is wrong and turn away from it. It requires more than being moved by a sermon. It requires a deliberate commitment to follow Jesus and pursue what God has promised.

Romans 12:2 encourages believers not to conform to the pattern of this world, but to be transformed by the renewing of their minds. This reminds us that the values of the surrounding culture should not automatically become the standards by which we live.

**KEY LESSONS FROM THIS MESSAGE**

1. Decide what kind of future you want before the world's priorities decide for you.
2. Never allow material success to replace fellowship with Jesus.
3. Learn from Noah, who remained righteous in a corrupt generation.
4. Recognise the distractions that gradually weaken your spiritual convictions.
5. Do not measure your life only by status, wealth, popularity, or recognition.
6. Remain faithful to God even when your convictions are unpopular.
7. Take deliberate steps to reject sin and pursue God's purpose for your life.

**A QUESTION FOR YOUR HEART**

If you gained everything you wanted in this world but lost your fellowship with Jesus, would you still consider your life successful?

Watch this teaching by Apostle Arome Osayi and take time to examine your priorities. Share this message with someone who needs encouragement to remain faithful to God in a world full of distractions.

Whether you're newly married, have been married for years, or are preparing for marriage, these principles will help you build a healthier and stronger relationship.

In this video, you'll discover:
 The five decisions that can transform your marriage
 How to communicate effectively during conflict
 Why forgiveness is essential for a healthy relationship
 The importance of commitment over emotions
 Biblical principles for building a lasting marriage

A thriving marriage isn't built by perfect people—it's built by two people who continually choose love, grace, commitment, and growth.

videos.title: The Power of Timing | Funke Felix -Adejumo
videos.description:
Is God making you wait? Don’t give up—your timing matters!

In this powerful and inspiring message, Funke Felix-Adejumo shares timeless wisdom on the power of divine timing and why understanding God’s seasons is essential to fulfilling your purpose.

There are moments when we want things to happen immediately, but God’s timing is often connected to our preparation, maturity, purpose, and destiny. Learning when to wait, prepare, move, and act can make the difference between simply having an opportunity and being ready to maximize it.

In this message, you will be encouraged to:

✨ Understand the importance of God’s timing
✨ Recognize the seasons and opportunities around you
✨ Learn patience while waiting for your breakthrough
✨ Avoid rushing into things before their appointed time
✨ Trust God even when you cannot see the full picture
✨ Prepare yourself for what God has destined for you
✨ Walk confidently in your purpose and calling

Remember: A delay does not mean God has forgotten you. Sometimes, what feels like a delay is actually preparation for something greater.

Take time to listen, reflect, and allow this message to strengthen your faith and renew your confidence in God’s plan for your life.

videos.title: Do Not Underestimate Someone Who Is Building His Life in the Holy Ghost - Dr. Arome Osayi
videos.description:
DO NOT UNDERESTIMATE THE POTENTIAL OF A LIFE BUILT IN THE HOLY GHOST | APOSTLE AROME OSAYI

Never underestimate a person who recognises the potential available through the Holy Spirit and remains committed to developing their spiritual life. In this powerful teaching, Apostle Arome Osayi speaks about spiritual growth, overcoming reproach, breaking free from limitations, and becoming equipped to fulfil God's purpose.

There are seasons when a person's circumstances seem to tell a story of restriction. Family history, rejection, repeated setbacks, and the expectations of others can make it difficult to imagine a different future. But this message challenges believers not to allow their present condition to determine what they believe is possible.

**KEEP BUILDING YOUR SPIRITUAL LIFE**

Apostle Arome Osayi emphasises the importance of recognising the potential available in the Holy Ghost and continuing to build upon it. Spiritual growth requires commitment. It is not enough to know that God has placed potential within you. You must also be willing to develop your spiritual life through prayer, obedience, the Word of God, and consistent fellowship with the Holy Spirit.

Growth may not produce immediate changes in your circumstances, but it develops your capacity to respond to life's challenges with greater wisdom, faith, and spiritual maturity.

Do not underestimate what God can accomplish through a life that is continually being developed in Him. Instead of allowing discouragement to stop your progress, remain committed to becoming the person God has called you to be.

**WHEN REPROACH AND LIMITATIONS NO LONGER DEFINE YOUR FUTURE**

In this message, Apostle Arome Osayi describes chains of reproach that keep a person in the wilderness and limitations that affect families, clans, and communities. His teaching encourages believers to look beyond inherited expectations and remain committed to spiritual development.

Isaiah 10:27 speaks of the yoke being destroyed because of the anointing. The imagery of a yoke represents something that restrains or burdens a person. The message uses this picture to emphasise the importance of spiritual growth and the work of God in bringing freedom from limitations.

The focus is not on accepting defeat because of your background or present circumstances. It is on continuing to grow in God and allowing that growth to shape how you live, serve, and fulfil your purpose.

**YOUR GROWTH CAN INFLUENCE MORE THAN YOURSELF**

One of the striking ideas in this teaching is that a person's development can have significance beyond their individual life. Apostle Arome Osayi speaks about destinies within a tribe, clan, and community being affected by the emergence of someone who has built spiritual capacity.

Your growth can influence your family, encourage others, and help create new possibilities for the people around you. When you develop wisdom, character, spiritual maturity, and the ability to serve, your impact can extend beyond your immediate circumstances.

This is a reminder to take your spiritual development seriously. You are not only preparing yourself to face today's challenges. You are also developing the capacity to contribute meaningfully to the lives of others.

**KEY LESSONS FROM THIS MESSAGE**

1. Recognise the potential available through the Holy Spirit.
2. Commit to consistent spiritual growth rather than waiting for circumstances to change.
3. Do not allow reproach, rejection, or your background to define your future.
4. Build your spiritual capacity through prayer, Scripture, obedience, and fellowship with God.
5. Understand that growth requires patience, discipline, and perseverance.
6. Develop yourself so that you can serve others and fulfil your God given purpose.
7. Remember that your present limitations do not have to determine the full story of your life.

**KEEP BUILDING**

What would happen if you stopped measuring your future by the limitations surrounding you and started focusing on the spiritual life you need to build?

This teaching by Apostle Arome Osayi is an encouragement to keep growing, remain steadfast in God, and develop the potential He has placed within you. Do not give up because your current circumstances have not changed. Continue building your life in the Holy Ghost and preparing yourself for the work God has called you to do.

Watch, reflect on this message, and share it with someone who needs encouragement to keep growing in God. Subscribe to Apostle Arome Osayi for more biblical teachings on spiritual growth, the Holy Spirit, prayer, faith, and fulfilling God's purpose.

videos.title: The Proceeding Word of God: How to Know What God Wants You to Do - Dr. Arome Osayi
videos.description:
How do you know what God wants you to do when you have the resources, connections, ability, and opportunity to act? In this powerful teaching, Apostle Arome Osayi explains the importance of living by the proceeding Word of God and aligning your decisions with God's instruction and purpose.

Drawing from Matthew 4:1–4, this message examines the temptation of Jesus in the wilderness and the significance of His response to Satan: “Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.”

Jesus demonstrated that human life was designed to depend on more than physical provision, personal ability, or natural resources. The believer must learn to live in alignment with what God is saying and follow His instructions, even when other options appear attractive or more convenient.

In this sermon, Apostle Arome Osayi teaches about fulfilling all righteousness, remaining under God's government, preparing spiritually for the challenges of destiny, and understanding why the ability to do something does not automatically mean that it is what God wants you to do.

THE IMPORTANCE OF THE PROCEEDING WORD OF GOD

A central lesson in this message is that believers must not allow opportunity, influence, money, or personal ability to become substitutes for divine instruction. There may be many available options, but spiritual maturity requires the discernment to identify the path that aligns with God's purpose.

Apostle Arome Osayi also discusses the importance of recording what God communicates, developing sensitivity to His voice, and maintaining a life of prayer and spiritual discipline. The believer must be prepared before the testing of faith arrives.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

• What Jesus meant when He said that man shall live by every proceeding word of God.

• Why fulfilling all righteousness requires obedience even when it does not appear convenient.

• How the temptation of Jesus in the wilderness reveals principles for spiritual warfare and destiny.

• Why you must not act merely because you have the ability, money, influence, or opportunity.

• The relationship between fasting, prayer, spiritual preparation, and overcoming the influence of your environment.

• Why believers must learn to recognize and record God's instructions.

• What it means to remain aligned with God's purpose for your generation.

• Why the Church must awaken to its spiritual responsibility and respond to God's burden through prayer and intercession.

JESUS, THE PATTERN MAN

The sermon also examines Jesus as the pattern for a life that pleases God. His obedience, including His decision to fulfill all righteousness, demonstrates the importance of living according to the Father's will.

The temptation in the wilderness was not simply about bread. It raised the question of whether Jesus would act independently of the Father's direction. His response reveals a foundational principle for Christian living: the Word of God must govern our decisions and conduct.

SCRIPTURES TO STUDY

Matthew 4:1–4: Jesus is tempted in the wilderness and declares the importance of living by God's Word.

Genesis 1:26: God's original intention concerning humanity.

Revelation 19:9–10: The testimony of Jesus and the spirit of prophecy.

Acts 9:1–6: The encounter that changed Saul's direction and mission.

1 John 5:6–8: The biblical passage concerning the witnesses of Jesus Christ.

WHO SHOULD WATCH THIS MESSAGE?

This teaching is for Christians seeking to deepen their relationship with God, believers looking for spiritual direction, ministers of the Gospel, intercessors, and everyone who desires to fulfil God's purpose without being led merely by human ability or outward opportunity.

If you desire to grow in spiritual discernment, prayer, obedience, and sensitivity to the Holy Spirit, this message will challenge you to examine how you make decisions and how closely your life aligns with God's instruction.

ABOUT APOSTLE AROME OSAYI

Apostle Arome Osayi teaches on the Christian faith, spiritual growth, prayer, righteousness, the Holy Spirit, and the purposes of God. His teachings challenge believers to grow in their understanding of Scripture and to pursue a deeper, more disciplined walk with God.

WATCH, SHARE, AND SUBSCRIBE

Watch this message prayerfully and reflect on the decisions you are making in this season.

Subscribe to the channel for more biblical teachings from Apostle Arome Osayi on spiritual growth, prayer, divine direction, Christian maturity, and the work of the Holy Spirit.

Share this teaching with someone who needs direction, spiritual encouragement, or a deeper understanding of how to walk in the will of God.

JOIN THE CONVERSATION

What does it mean to you to live by the proceeding Word of God? Share your thoughts in the comments.

#ApostleAromeOsayi #ProceedingWordOfGod #HearingGod #DivineDirection #ChristianTeaching #BibleTeaching #SpiritualGrowth #Prayer #HolySpirit #ChristianFaith #GodsWill #Matthew4

videos.title: What Nigeria Needs Is Not Just More Money, but Hearts Transformed by God - Dr. Arome Osayi
videos.description:
WHAT NIGERIA NEEDS TO RESTORE ITS GREATNESS | APOSTLE AROME OSAYI

Can a nation become truly great through financial resources alone? What happens when a country possesses enormous natural wealth but lacks the integrity and selflessness needed to manage those resources for the good of its people?

In this thought provoking teaching, Apostle Arome Osayi explores the relationship between righteousness, spiritual awakening, patriotism, and economic development. Speaking about Nigeria's potential and its history, he argues that national transformation requires more than money. It requires people whose hearts have been changed and who are willing to put the wellbeing of others above personal gain.

WHY MONEY ALONE CANNOT BUILD A GREAT NATION

Nigeria is richly endowed with natural resources, including oil, and has enormous economic potential. Yet natural wealth does not automatically translate into shared prosperity, effective leadership, or improved living conditions for citizens.

Apostle Arome Osayi reflects on his experience working in the oil industry and argues that the problem cannot be understood simply as a shortage of money. In his view, a critical missing ingredient is the kind of character that enables people to manage resources responsibly and serve the common good.

When greed, corruption, and personal interest take priority over the wellbeing of others, even a wealthy nation can struggle to fulfil its potential. This is why the message challenges Nigerians to look beyond economic resources and consider the values that shape how those resources are managed.

**THE CROSS AND THE TRANSFORMATION OF THE HUMAN HEART**

A central theme of this teaching is that righteousness and selflessness are essential to restoring genuine patriotism. Apostle Arome Osayi describes people who have been shaped by the cross as people who can move beyond selfish ambition and become committed to serving a purpose greater than themselves.

This principle applies to leadership, business, public service, and everyday citizenship. A transformed heart should influence how a person handles money, exercises authority, treats others, and fulfils responsibilities.

Spiritual transformation is not only about personal religious experience. It should also be reflected in integrity, compassion, accountability, and a willingness to contribute to the wellbeing of society.

**THE CONNECTION BETWEEN SPIRITUAL AWAKENING AND ECONOMIC PROGRESS**

Apostle Arome Osayi also teaches that spiritual awakening can be accompanied by economic growth. He uses the biblical account of the wise men who visited Jesus and brought gold, frankincense, and myrrh to illustrate the relationship between spiritual events and the resources that can accompany them.

In Matthew 2:11, the wise men enter the house, see the child Jesus with Mary, and present their gifts. The teaching uses this account to draw attention to how resources can support a purpose that extends beyond an individual.

The broader challenge is to consider how spiritual renewal might influence the economic life of a community through changed values, responsible stewardship, productive work, generosity, and service.

Spiritual revival does not automatically guarantee an economic boom. However, the values associated with genuine transformation, including honesty, discipline, responsibility, and concern for others, can contribute to healthier institutions and stronger communities.

**KEY LESSONS FROM THIS MESSAGE**

1. Natural resources alone do not guarantee national greatness.
2. Righteousness and integrity matter in leadership and public service.
3. Genuine patriotism requires a willingness to serve the common good.
4. Personal transformation should influence how people handle wealth and authority.
5. Spiritual renewal can encourage values that support responsible economic activity.
6. National progress requires people who are committed to something greater than personal gain.
7. Economic resources should be managed responsibly and directed towards meaningful purposes.

**A QUESTION FOR NIGERIA**

What could change if more people in positions of influence placed integrity, service, and the wellbeing of Nigerians above personal gain?

This message by Apostle Arome Osayi challenges believers to pray for their nation while also examining the character and values needed to build it. Lasting progress calls for more than resources. It calls for people who are willing to use their abilities, opportunities, and influence responsibly.

Watch this Short, share your thoughts, and send this message to someone who cares about Nigeria's future. Subscribe to Apostle Arome Osayi for more teachings on righteousness, spiritual awakening, leadership, and the impact of faith on everyday life.

#ApostleAromeOsayi #Nigeria #NationalTransformation #SpiritualAwakening #Righteousness #ChristianLeadership #Patriotism #EconomicDevelopment #FaithAndSociety #BibleTeaching

videos.title: The Requirements for the Apostolic Office | Apostle Arome Osayi
videos.description:
What does it truly take to function in the apostolic office? Is it enough to be anointed, gifted, influential, or recognised as an apostle? In this powerful biblical teaching, Apostle Arome Osayi examines the requirements for apostolic ministry through Acts 1, revealing the spiritual depth, character, preparation, and kingdom commitment required of those called to this office.

Using the replacement of Judas in Acts 1 as his starting point, Apostle Arome Osayi explains that apostolic responsibility is not something to approach casually. Judas fell from his ministry and apostleship through transgression, and another was appointed to take his place. This account reveals the seriousness of the calling and the need for those who occupy spiritual offices to remain faithful.

One of the central lessons in this teaching is that **the apostolic office requires more than anointing. It requires a life that has been formed through intimacy with Jesus, spiritual discipline, character, and the dealings of the Holy Spirit.**

Apostle Arome Osayi explores the qualifications outlined in Acts 1:21–23 and explains the significance of accompanying Jesus, witnessing His resurrection, and participating in the spiritual processes that prepared the early apostles for their assignment.

### KEY TEACHINGS IN THIS MESSAGE

**1. The Seriousness of the Apostolic Calling**

Acts 1 reveals that Judas lost his place through transgression. Apostle Arome Osayi explains the distinction between the work or office that another person can take up and the personal spiritual responsibility attached to an individual's calling.

**2. Character Is More Important Than Anointing Alone**

Drawing from 1 Timothy 3, the message highlights the character requirements associated with spiritual oversight. Being blameless, sober, hospitable, faithful, and ready to teach are not optional qualities for those entrusted with the care of souls.

**3. Intimacy With Jesus Is the First Requirement**

Acts 1:21 identifies those who accompanied Jesus throughout His earthly ministry. Apostle Arome Osayi explains that the reference point of an apostle is intimacy with Jesus. Apostolic ministry requires a genuine relationship with Christ and a willingness to stand for His purposes.

**4. The Application of the Death of Christ**

Apostolic preparation involves more than understanding the death of Jesus intellectually. The implications of His death must become evident in the minister's life. Self-centredness, pride, personal ambition, and the desire for self-glory must be dealt with so that the minister can serve God's purposes faithfully.

**5. Depth in the Holy Spirit**

The message emphasises sustained fellowship with the Holy Spirit. A minister must develop spiritual depth that remains stable through seasons of scarcity, pressure, suffering, and unanswered questions.

**6. Resurrection Power and Spiritual Capacity**

The resurrection of Jesus is central to the Christian life and apostolic witness. A minister must demonstrate the victory and transforming power of the Spirit who raised Christ from the dead.

**7. Understanding the Kingdom of God**

Acts 1:3 records that Jesus spent forty days speaking to His disciples about the kingdom of God. Apostle Arome Osayi explains that apostolic ministry must be governed by a clear kingdom mandate, not reduced to personal ambition, prosperity, or isolated ministerial activities.

**8. Prayer and the Ministry of the Word**

The days between the ascension of Jesus and Pentecost were days of travail and prayer. The message stresses that prayer and the ministry of the Word are foundational responsibilities for every kingdom functionary, regardless of their particular assignment.

### SCRIPTURES REFERENCED
Acts 1:15–26
1 Timothy 3:1–7
John 20:21–22
John 7:16
Philippians 3:10
Acts 1:3–8
Matthew 6:33
Isaiah 66:8

### WHO SHOULD WATCH THIS MESSAGE?

This teaching is particularly important for:
- Ministers, pastors, prophets, evangelists, and teachers.
- Those who believe they have an apostolic calling.
- Church leaders responsible for spiritual oversight.
- Christians seeking to understand the demands of ministry.
- Those who desire deeper intimacy with Jesus and the Holy Spirit.
- Anyone seeking to understand the relationship between character, spiritual power, and kingdom purpose.

Apostolic ministry is a serious responsibility. The calling must be accompanied by the character, spiritual depth, and preparation required to fulfil God's purpose.

videos.title: The Story of David and Goliath Isn't What You Think
videos.description:
We all know the legendary tale of David and Goliath: a young shepherd boy armed with nothing but a sling takes down an invincible, towering giant. But when we look closer at the history, geography, and what is actually mentioned in the Bible, a different picture begins to emerge.

5 Reasons Getting Married Is The Best Decision You Will Ever Make | Kingsley Okonkwo

Why get married? Is marriage still worth it today? In this powerful teaching, Kingsley Okonkwo shares 5 important reasons getting married can be one of the best decisions you will ever make and why understanding God’s purpose for marriage can completely change the way you approach relationships.

Marriage is more than finding someone you love or having a beautiful wedding. A healthy marriage provides an opportunity for companionship, partnership, personal growth, purpose, family, intimacy, and building a life with someone who shares your values and vision.

In this message, you’ll discover:
• 5 powerful reasons marriage is worth pursuing
• The purpose and benefits of marriage
• Why companionship matters in life
• How marriage can contribute to personal growth
• The importance of partnership between husband and wife
• Why choosing the right spouse is so important
• Biblical principles for building a healthy and lasting marriage
• How to prepare yourself for marriage, not just a wedding

Whether you are single, dating, engaged, newly married, or already years into marriage, this message will help you develop a healthier perspective on marriage and understand why building the right marriage can be one of life’s greatest investments.
Watch until the end and share this message with someone who needs a fresh perspective on love, relationships, dating and marriage.
Subscribe for more teachings from Kingsley Okonkwo on relationships, marriage, dating, love, family and personal growth.

videos.title: 1. Body of Christ vs. a Congregation: Understanding the Difference | Apostle Arome Osayi
videos.description:
Is there a difference between gathering people together as a congregation and becoming an expression of the Body of Christ? What does it mean to be part of the Body of Christ, and how should the Church function according to God's purpose?

In this teaching, Apostle Arome Osayi examines the distinction between a congregation and the Body of Christ, drawing from 1 Corinthians 12:13 and Hebrews 3:1. He explains that the Body of Christ is not simply a group of people who gather in one location. It is a spiritual reality brought about by the work of the Holy Spirit.

The Bible declares that by one Spirit, believers are baptized into one Body, whether Jews or Gentiles, bond or free. This means that the formation of the Body of Christ goes beyond physical gathering, denominational affiliation, or membership in a local assembly.

Apostle Arome Osayi also explores the purpose of a congregation, the relationship between believers, spiritual unity, and the responsibility of apostolic leadership. He challenges the tendency to evaluate a congregation merely by the number of people attending or belonging to it. The deeper question is whether that gathering is becoming an expression of Christ and advancing God's purpose in its territory.

**KEY TEACHINGS IN THIS MESSAGE**

• The three baptisms discussed in the New Testament: water baptism, baptism in the Holy Ghost, and baptism into the Body of Christ.

• What 1 Corinthians 12:13 reveals about the Holy Spirit bringing believers into one Body.

• Why the Body of Christ is more than a physical gathering of Christians.

• The distinction between a congregation and the spiritual reality of the Body of Christ.

• Why congregations exist and how they relate to God's purpose in a territory.

• The importance of spiritual unity and relationships among members of the Body.

• The role of apostolic leadership and spiritual authority within a congregation.

• Why the effectiveness of a congregation cannot be measured only by attendance and membership numbers.

• How the Church is called to become an expression of Christ and respond to God's purpose.

**BIBLE SCRIPTURES**

1 Corinthians 12:13  
Hebrews 3:1  
1 Corinthians 12:12–27  
Galatians 6:14  
John 17  
Ephesians 4:11–16  
Numbers 11:16–17

These passages provide a foundation for studying the spiritual formation, unity, leadership, and function of the Body of Christ.

**WHO SHOULD WATCH THIS MESSAGE?**

This teaching is important for pastors, apostles, church leaders, ministry workers, believers, and anyone seeking a deeper biblical understanding of the Church.

If you have ever wondered why the Body of Christ is more than a congregation, how spiritual unity works, or what God expects from a local assembly, this message will challenge you to examine the purpose and responsibility of the Church.

The Church is not merely defined by the people who gather in a building. There is a spiritual purpose behind the gathering, and believers must understand what it means to function as members of the Body of Christ.

**WATCH AND SHARE**

videos.title: Gratitude and Joy – A Message by Ibukun Awosika
videos.description:
In this powerful and timely message, Ibukun Awosika speaks on the importance of expressing gratitude to those who have helped us and the need to live each day with intentional joy.

In a world that often moves too fast to pause and reflect, this video is a reminder that no success happens in isolation. We are all standing on the shoulders of those who have supported, encouraged, guided, or uplifted us—whether in small or significant ways. Taking the time to say “thank you” is not just polite—it is honorable, biblical, and life-giving.

Alongside gratitude, Ibukun Awosika emphasizes the power of joy—not as a fleeting emotion, but as a lasting choice that strengthens the soul. Joy fuels resilience and keeps us grounded, even in tough seasons.

🙌 Be intentional today: show gratitude, and choose joy. Let those who have helped you know they made a difference.

videos.title: How We Reconstructed the Lost Floors of Herod's Temple Mount
videos.description:
What did the floors of Herod’s Temple Mount actually look like? For centuries, this remained an archaeological mystery—until a mountain of debris from the Temple Mount led to a groundbreaking discovery.

After thousands of tons of soil were removed from the site in 1999, the Temple Mount Sifting Project began recovering fragments of opus sectile—intricate, Roman-style stone tiles. In this video, we follow researcher Frankie Snyder as she uses math, geometry, and the unique patterns of Herod the Great to "reverse engineer" these ancient floors. By decoding Herod’s secret "Herodian Triangle," she has successfully reconstructed the breathtaking designs that once paved the Royal Stoa and the Temple Mount.

For the first time, we can visualize the very ground Jesus walked upon as He taught His disciples and drove out the money changers. Join us as we piece together the past and reveal the majesty of the Temple that Jesus knew, as well as its tragic destruction, which is commemorated every year on Tisha B'Av.

videos.title: Why Was Moses' Bronze Serpent Destroyed?
videos.description:
Why did King Hezekiah destroy a sacred relic given by God? 🐍✨For centuries after ~1440 BC, the Bronze Serpent stood as a symbol of God’s healing power. 

But by ~715 BC, it became known as "Nehushtan" and was turned into an object of worship inside the Temple of Solomon.   When the people began worshiping the bronze statue instead of God, King Hezekiah made the bold choice to smash the sacred artifact to end idolatry.

videos.title: The Hidden Blueprint in the Garden of Eden
videos.description:
Was the Garden of Eden actually the world’s very first temple? 
The Bible blueprints a three-part structure connecting Eden directly to Moses’s Tabernacle:
• Outer Courtyard = Outer World
• Holy Place = Holy Mountain
• Holy of Holies = Inner Garden   

While Adam was exiled toward the East, the High Priest walked Westward on the Day of Atonement—reversing the exile to re-enter the presence of God. 
Even the Golden Menorah in the Holy Place was styled after the Tree of Life with seven blossoming branches!  
Subscribe to Messages of Christ for more deep dives into biblical symbolism!

videos.title: Why Is There a “Swastika” on Herod’s Temple?
videos.description:
When building our 3D digital reconstruction of Herod’s Temple, historical accuracy had to come first. 
Archaeologists have uncovered over 500 architectural fragments from the Temple site—and more than 20 of them feature this distinct geometric motif. 
Centuries before its modern corruption, this classical meander pattern was standard in Greco-Roman architecture and widely used throughout first-century Judea, including synagogues like the one excavated at Magdala.   

Watch our full, detailed walkthrough of Herod's Temple right here on our channel to explore the entire reconstruction and the history behind every detail!

videos.title: Rev. Ntia Ntia's Prophetic Decree Over Ebuka Songs
videos.description:
When God gives you a message, you don’t have to become another person to make it heard.

There are people who sing songs, and there are people who sing messages.

These words from @ntiantiaunlimited came at a time when I needed them deeply. Sometimes when you refuse to follow the popular path, you may feel unseen, misunderstood, or even forgotten. When the message God has put in your heart is not always convenient for everyone, it can be tempting to change your sound just to be accepted.

But I am learning again: I was not sent to fit into a system, I was sent to carry a message.

To every minister, worshipper, preacher, songwriter, or believer who feels unnoticed because you have chosen to remain true to what God committed to you, please stay.

Don’t change your message because people are not celebrating it yet,
Don’t abandon your sound because others seem to be moving faster,
Don’t become someone else because their path appears more accepted.

There are people God has assigned to your voice. There are hearts your obedience will reach. And sometimes, God will send fathers who recognize what He placed in you, even when you cannot see it clearly yourself.

I am grateful for fathers who don’t just see the song, but see the message behind the song.

Stay with Jesus, Stay with the assignment, Stay with the truth.

What God has placed in you does not become less valuable because everyone doesn’t recognize it.

Keep singing the message. 🕊️

videos.description:
Happy Monday!

I hope you had an amazing and restful weekend.

I get asked about mentoring quite often, so here’s a quick tip:

How you approach a mentor matters.

Don’t approach a mentor thinking only about what you can get from them. Ask yourself, “How can I add value?”

Great mentoring relationships are built on more than access. Your attitude, preparation, willingness to learn, and ability to contribute all matter.

Don’t just seek value. Look for ways to add value too.

Have an amazing week!

#Mentoring #Leadership #PersonalGrowth #SHIFTS #SamAdeyemi

videos.title: Travis: A Soldier's Story | Full Documentary Movie
videos.description:
Travis: A Soldier’s Story is a challenging documentary featuring the inspiring true story of United States Army Staff Sergeant Travis Mills of the 82nd Airborne. Travis lost portions of both arms and legs as the result of an IED (improvised explosive device) on April 10, 2012 while on patrol during his third tour of duty in Afghanistan. Travis is one of just five quadruple-amputees from the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan to survive their injuries. Featuring powerful interviews and emotional reenactments from Travis and Kelsey Mills, and fellow soldiers who witnessed the events of April 10th, Travis: A Soldiers Story is an intimate look into the life of a wounded solider as he faces the unimaginable physical and emotional challenges of this life-altering injury. Travis’s story sheds light on the daily inward and outward struggles of our wounded veterans and the difficult rehabilitation processes they face; and Travis’s openness and incredible perseverance will challenge us to look at the way we deal with our own personal trials in life.

videos.title: YOUR DREAM JOB MIGHT NOT EXIST! | Here's What to Do Instead | Grace on Monday
videos.description:
What if the dream job you've been waiting for doesn't actually exist?

Many of us grew up believing that somewhere out there is a perfect job—one that aligns with our passions, pays well, fulfils us, and makes us excited to wake up every morning. But what happens when reality doesn't match the picture in our heads?

In this episode of Grace on Monday, we explore the idea that your dream job might not exist as you've imagined it. We discuss career expectations, purpose, passion, and navigating the realities of work while figuring out what a fulfilling career actually looks like.

In this conversation, we explore:

Is there really such a thing as a perfect job?
Are we putting too much pressure on our careers to fulfil us?
What happens when your passion doesn't pay the bills?
Should you pursue what you love or what you're good at?
How do you find purpose in a job that isn't your dream?
Can you build a fulfilling career without having everything figured out?
How does faith influence the way we approach work and career decisions?

Your career doesn't have to look exactly how you imagined it for it to be meaningful. Sometimes, the journey involves discovering new interests, developing your skills, and learning to make the most of the opportunities in front of you.

Watch the full episode and tell us in the comments: Do you believe everyone has a dream job, or is that an expectation we need to rethink?

If this conversation resonates with you, share it with someone navigating their career journey and subscribe for more conversations on faith, work, business, purpose, and everyday life.

About Grace on Monday

Grace on Monday is a podcast exploring how faith, grace, and purpose intersect with our careers, businesses, and everyday work beyond the four walls of the church.

videos.title: YOUR DREAM JOB MIGHT NOT EXIST!
videos.description:
What if the dream job you've been waiting for doesn't actually exist?

Many of us grew up believing that somewhere out there is a perfect job—one that aligns with our passions, pays well, fulfils us, and makes us excited to wake up every morning. But what happens when reality doesn't match the picture in our heads?

In this episode of Grace on Monday, we explore the idea that your dream job might not exist as you've imagined it. We discuss career expectations, purpose, passion, and navigating the realities of work while figuring out what a fulfilling career actually looks like.

In this conversation, we explore:

Is there really such a thing as a perfect job?
Are we putting too much pressure on our careers to fulfil us?
What happens when your passion doesn't pay the bills?
Should you pursue what you love or what you're good at?
How do you find purpose in a job that isn't your dream?
Can you build a fulfilling career without having everything figured out?
How does faith influence the way we approach work and career decisions?

Your career doesn't have to look exactly how you imagined it for it to be meaningful. Sometimes, the journey involves discovering new interests, developing your skills, and learning to make the most of the opportunities in front of you.

Watch the full episode and tell us in the comments: Do you believe everyone has a dream job, or is that an expectation we need to rethink?

If this conversation resonates with you, share it with someone navigating their career journey and subscribe for more conversations on faith, work, business, purpose, and everyday life.

King Tonto- Dike @tontlet shared on how "being a mother has made her have a Soul" and how she puts her child first before anything. It's not the sound you make when you have a piece of hot yam in your mouth 😁. It's the sound of tongues expressing a truth too hard for regular words. 

It's about the deity or godhead of Jesus Christ. 

Jesus is God, however offensive that may sound to anybody. 
He pre-existed the New Testament where the Bible bears explicit record of Him. He was in the very beginning. 
He is not a white man's creation to placate and deceive the rest of us, as many have believed. 
He is as much an interruption of the African belief system as He is of the "Oyibo" and the Jewish systems. That's why He was feared, hated, and crucified. 

This version is a celebration of the lyrics of the song. It sets out the theme of the song above the beats and rhythm 

I see an aloof commentator in the person of Buchi (depicted mostly by mouth and hat) confronting the contrary mindset of the people of my time with the truth that JESUS IS GOD.

videos.title: Solving Problems I (Audio) | Pastor Sam Adeyemi | Sunday Service | November 8, 2026.
videos.description:
One of the most certain things in life is uncertainty. But in the middle of changing circumstances and complex challenges, God is raising people who will become solutions to the problems around them.



In this message, Solving Problems (Part 1), Pastor Sam Adeyemi challenges us to rethink how we see ourselves, recognise our capacity for leadership and become people who bring solutions wherever we find ourselves. Drawing from 1 Samuel 16:15–19, we explore the story of David, whose abilities brought him before the king. His story reminds us that developing the capacity to solve problems can open doors to opportunities, promotion and greater influence.



In this message, we explore:



The Power of the Right Identity: Become conscious of who God has called you to be and see yourself as a solution provider. Think About the Who, Not Just the How: Every great vision requires the right people. Becoming the right person can create opportunities for greater impact.



Leadership Through Problem-Solving: Leadership is influence, and solving problems is one way to build that influence.



Overcoming the Fear of Man: Break free from low self-esteem, intimidation and the fear of man-made systems. Becoming God's Solution Provider: You are not a victim of circumstances. With the Holy Spirit, you can make a difference wherever God places you. Jesus attracted crowds because He met needs and solved problems.



Rather than running away from people and situations that require solutions, we must develop the capacity to make a difference. This is your season to become the person they call when there is a problem to solve.



Your solutions will create opportunities for promotion and multiply your influence.



Scripture References 1 Samuel 16:15–19; Proverbs 22:29; Matthew 4:22–25; John 9:5; Acts 4:13; Matthew 16:17.



Watch, be blessed and share this message with someone who needs to hear it.



#DaystarChristianCentre #SolvingProblems #PastorSamAdeyemi #SundayService

Can Nigeria get 2027 right?

As Nigeria marks 66 years of independence and looks towards the 2027 general elections, this honest conversation asks a bigger question: what must change, not only in our leadership, but in us as citizens?

In this special Independence Service panel discussion hosted by Family Worship Centre, Abuja, Pastor Sarah Omakwu is joined by leading voices in governance, civic engagement, public affairs and social development to examine Nigeria's leadership challenges and the responsibility we all carry in shaping the country's future.

The conversation explores leadership and accountability, corruption, economic hardship, insecurity, electoral participation, voter apathy, governance, institutional failure, citizen responsibility, the role of the Church in public life and what Nigerians must do differently as we approach the 2027 elections.

The panel features:

Mr. Wale Oluwade - Journalist, host of Naija Unfiltered Podcast on Symfoni TV and moderator of the conversation

Hon. Henry Shield - Political commentator, activist, public affairs analyst and Head of Mission at the Leadership & Accountability Initiative

Mr. Samson Itodo - Civic advocate and Executive Director of Yiaga Africa

Comrade Ene Obi - Civil society leader and Executive Director of the Ene Obi Center for Development

Major Lancelot Anyanya - Board Of Trustees Member Family Worship Centre

This is NOT a conversation about endorsing a political party or candidate. It is a conversation about Nigeria: responsible citizenship, credible leadership, democratic participation, faith, accountability and the choices that will shape our collective future.

Watch the full conversation and tell us in the comments:

What must Nigerians do differently before the 2027 elections?

If you believe this is a conversation more Nigerians need to hear, share this video.

videos.description:
EVERYONE HAS YOUR NUMBER FOR A CRISIS. WHO CAN YOU CALL IN YOURS? 💔

You are the “strong one.”

The one who answers.
The one who listens.
The one who finds the words when everyone else has run out.

But some days, you finish encouraging someone, putting down the phone, and cringing. 🥺

You wish someone would ask, “How are you, really?” and stay long enough to hear the answer.

Being dependable does not mean you never get tired. And being strong does not make your need for care disappear.

You deserve somewhere you can say, “I’m struggling,” without having to soften it with, “But I’ll be fine.” ❤️‍🩹

Somewhere, you can speak honestly, receive support, and let someone care for you, too.

🎥 If this is you, let this be your reminder: you do not have to reach the breaking point before asking for help.

📩 Send us a DM or WhatsApp message using the number on your screen.

💬 When did someone last ask how you were and really listen?

Share this with the person who always shows up for everyone. They may need someone to show up for them today. 🤍

videos.description:
Healing from a Narcissistic Relationship | A Therapist Explains

Recovering from a narcissistic relationship is about far more than simply moving on. If you’ve experienced narcissistic abuse, emotional manipulation, gaslighting, love bombing, or the confusing cycle of idealization and devaluation, this video will help you understand what genuine healing actually requires.

In this in-depth conversation, I explain the psychology behind narcissistic relationships, why recovery often feels so difficult, and how to rebuild your sense of identity, reality, and emotional safety after psychological abuse.

In this video, you’ll learn:
• Why healing from narcissistic abuse is different from ordinary heartbreak
• The hidden grief after a narcissistic relationship
• How gaslighting damages your confidence and self-trust
• Why narcissists target empathetic people
• The psychology behind trauma bonds and emotional manipulation
• Why obsessively trying to understand the narcissist keeps you stuck
• How to rebuild your identity after emotional abuse
• Practical steps toward emotional healing and healthy relationships

Whether you’re recovering from narcissistic abuse, emotional abuse, a toxic relationship, manipulation, trauma bonding, or simply trying to understand why the relationship changed so drastically, this video offers both psychological insight and practical hope.

If you’re a single woman committed to emotional healing, personal growth, and preparing for healthy relationships, I’d love to invite you to Elevate Academy. It’s a community where we explore emotional health, relationship wisdom, faith, and lasting transformation together.

videos.description:
Take a moment to breathe. You don't need to burn out.
In this video, we are having a real, honest conversation about the pressure to constantly perform. videos.title: 🚬🎰 “JUST ONE MORE, THEN I'LL STOP.”
videos.description:
🚬🎰 “JUST ONE MORE, THEN I'LL STOP.”

How many times have you made that promise to yourself?

“One more cigarette.”
“One more bet.”
“Just this last time.”

You convince yourself you are still in control. You promise to quit tomorrow, cut down next week, or stop after recovering the money you lost.

But gradually, what seemed like a harmless habit began to take control of your decisions, finances, health, and everyday life.

You may start hiding your habits, making excuses, breaking promises, and struggling to stop despite knowing the consequences.

The truth is that addiction doesn't always begin with a decision to become dependent. Sometimes, it develops through repeated choices that become increasingly difficult to control.

❤️‍🩹 Whether it is smoking, gambling, or both, you don't have to wait until everything falls apart before seeking help.

At MendingLives, we screen before we treat. We seek to understand the underlying psychological and behavioural patterns so that appropriate support and treatment can be recommended.

📩 Take the first step today. Send us a DM or WhatsApp message using the number on your screen.

🤍 Your struggle does not have to become your story forever.

🌐 www.mendinglives.ng

#AddictionRecovery #MentalHealth #SmokingAddiction #GoViral #FYP

videos.title: 💔 WHO TOLD YOU GRIEF HAS A DEADLINE?“
videos.description:
💔 WHO TOLD YOU GRIEF HAS A DEADLINE?

“It's been years. Why are you still grieving?”

Sometimes, the words people use hurt more than they realise.

Grief is not a timetable. And no, you don't become less grateful, less spiritual or less faithful because you're still struggling with a loss.

🎥 In this video, I talk about the dangerous pressure people put on those who are grieving: the pressure to “move on” before they're ready.

If you can't comfort someone, please don't add to their pain.

And if you've been carrying a burden in your heart for a long time, you don't have to carry it alone. A safe space to talk can be the beginning of a different journey. ❤️‍🩹

videos.title: 🌅 HAPPY NEW WEEK! ❤️
videos.description:
🌅 HAPPY NEW WEEK! ❤️

My prayer for you this week is that life becomes pleasant for you. May you enjoy the fruit of your labour, experience peace, and find the courage to live free. 🙏

💔 WHAT IF THE PERSON YOU ARE AFRAID TO LOSE IS THE SAME PERSON HURTING YOU?

A parent. A sibling. A spouse. A partner. Someone you love and trust.

What happens when the person who should protect you becomes the person you need protection from?

You know the relationship is hurting you. You have cried, prayed, forgiven, and hoped things would change.

Yet you find it difficult to walk away. Why?

Because fear keeps asking:

💔 Where will I go?
💔 Who will love me?
💔 How will I survive?
💔 What if I end up alone?

Sometimes, you are not staying because you are happy. You are staying because you are afraid.

This painful emotional attachment can sometimes be a sign of trauma bonding.

❤️‍🩹 PLEASE REMEMBER: YOU CAN LOVE SOMEONE AND STILL RECOGNISE THAT THEY ARE HURTING YOU.

Being attached to someone does not mean you are safe with them.

You deserve peace, safety, and healthy love. And if leaving feels dangerous, you deserve support in finding a safe way forward.

🎥 WATCH THIS VIDEO. I explain why people become attached to those who hurt them and why breaking free can feel almost impossible.

📩 Are you silently struggling with this? Send us a DM or WhatsApp message using the number on your screen. Help is available.

🌐 www.mendinglives.ng

💬 LET’S TALK: Why do you think people sometimes choose the pain of staying over the fear of leaving?

❤️ Share this video. Someone needs to hear this today.

#TraumaBonding #EmotionalAbuse #ToxicRelationships #TraumaRecovery #HealthyRelationships #MentalHealthAwareness #MendingLives #DrOlufunkeAdetuberu #StopGuessingStartTherapy

videos.title: You cannot claim to trust God while seeking answers from other spiritual alternatives.
videos.description:
Jesus said, “Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.” (Matthew 5:8, NKJV).
Purity of heart is about more than outward conduct. It speaks to the condition of our hearts, our devotion and where we place our trust. God does not share His place in our lives with other powers or spiritual practices.
You cannot mix your faith in God with practices that contradict His Word and expect to walk in the fullness of that relationship.
Let your heart belong to God completely. No alternatives, no divided allegiance.

videos.description:
👀 BEFORE YOU CALL YOUR CHILD “LAZY,” ASK: “WHAT IS MAKING THIS SO HARD FOR YOU?”

You see unfinished homework.
They may be struggling to concentrate.

You see them taking too long.
They may need more time to understand.

You notice they have become unusually quiet.
There may be something they do not yet know how to explain. ❤️‍🩹

Sometimes, a child is trying harder than anyone can see.

🎥 Watch this animation, then pause and think about the child behind the behaviour.

Not every struggle means something is seriously wrong. But a repeated pattern deserves attention, curiosity and care. 🌱

💬 Try asking today:
“What feels difficult for you?”
“What would help?”

Listen. Give them time to answer. Let them know they can speak without being called names. 🤍

If a pattern keeps worrying you, professional support can help you understand what may be happening and what support your child needs.

videos.description:
💔 CAN YOU GRIEVE SOMEONE WHO IS STILL ALIVE?

Yes. You can sit across from someone you love and miss the person you thought they were.

Maybe you still see them at family gatherings. They ask how you are, and you say, “I’m fine.” How do you tell them, “I miss how safe I used to feel with you”?

Sometimes, that is what grief sounds like. You are grieving the trust that was broken, what was taken from you, or the future you once pictured with them. And because that person is still here, the people around you may never think to ask what you have lost.

🎥 In this video, I talk about that quiet kind of grief. If it feels familiar, you deserve a place to say what happened in your own words without having to pretend you are fine.

At MendingLives, we screen before we treat, because your story deserves more than assumptions.

videos.title: 💔 CONCERNED ABOUT YOUR CHILD'S EMOTIONAL WELL-BEING?
videos.description:
💔 CONCERNED ABOUT YOUR CHILD'S EMOTIONAL WELL-BEING?

Parenting goes beyond providing food, shelter and education. It also means understanding your child's personality, listening to their concerns and creating an environment where they feel safe enough to express themselves.

Every child is different. What works for one child may not work for another.

Here are three important ways to support your child's emotional well-being:

1️⃣ Understand their personality. Learn how your child thinks, responds, expresses emotions and relates with others.

2️⃣ Listen and communicate better. Create room for honest conversations without constant criticism, judgment or comparison.

3️⃣ Seek professional help and therapy when necessary. Don't ignore persistent emotional or behavioural changes. Early support can make a meaningful difference.

Remember, a child who feels understood is more likely to feel safe, valued and emotionally supported.

❤️ Your child doesn't just need you to raise them. They need you to understand them.

At MendingLives Therapeutic Services, we are committed to supporting healthier families and emotionally healthier children.

videos.title: Solving Problems I | Pastor Sam Adeyemi | Sunday Service | November 8, 2026.
videos.description:
One of the most certain things in life is uncertainty. But in the middle of changing circumstances and complex challenges, God is raising people who will become solutions to the problems around them.

In this message, Solving Problems (Part 1), Pastor Sam Adeyemi challenges us to rethink how we see ourselves, recognise our capacity for leadership and become people who bring solutions wherever we find ourselves.

Drawing from 1 Samuel 16:15–19, we explore the story of David, whose abilities brought him before the king. His story reminds us that developing the capacity to solve problems can open doors to opportunities, promotion and greater influence.

In this message, we explore:

The Power of the Right Identity: Become conscious of who God has called you to be and see yourself as a solution provider.

Think About the Who, Not Just the How: Every great vision requires the right people. Becoming the right person can create opportunities for greater impact.

Leadership Through Problem-Solving: Leadership is influence, and solving problems is one way to build that influence.

Overcoming the Fear of Man: Break free from low self-esteem, intimidation and the fear of man-made systems.

Becoming God's Solution Provider: You are not a victim of circumstances. With the Holy Spirit, you can make a difference wherever God places you.

Jesus attracted crowds because He met needs and solved problems. Rather than running away from people and situations that require solutions, we must develop the capacity to make a difference.

This is your season to become the person they call when there is a problem to solve. Your solutions will create opportunities for promotion and multiply your influence.

Scripture References

1 Samuel 16:15–19; Proverbs 22:29; Matthew 4:22–25; John 9:5; Acts 4:13; Matthew 16:17.

Watch, be blessed and share this message with someone who needs to hear it.

#DaystarChristianCentre #SolvingProblems #PastorSamAdeyemi #SundayService

videos.title: THE CONNECTION BETWEEN INFLUENCE, CHARACTER & WEALTH
videos.description:
This video features a deep conversation between Femi Lazarus and Ayesha Bedwei, a partner at PWC. The discussion centers on the interconnection of influence, character, and sustainable wealth creation (0:00 - 1:07:23). Aisha shares her journey to the top, starting from humble beginnings and overcoming personal tragedies to achieve success in a global firm.

Key Highlights:

Character as the Foundation: Aisha emphasizes that integrity, consistency, and how one treats people are the most critical factors for long-term career growth, often outweighing technical brilliance (10:05 - 12:24).
The Wealth Gap: The discussion addresses why talented, high-character individuals still face a wealth gap. Aisha attributes this to a lack of financial fluency, the inability to articulate personal value, and not letting one's income "work" or produce (18:10 - 28:07).
Mindset and Success: They discuss the power of the mind, arguing that success is not a matter of luck but of conscious focus, avoiding limiting beliefs, and preparing oneself to become the "version" of the individual required for success (38:38 - 40:44, 1:02:28 - 1:06:11).
The Role of Environment: Both stress the importance of surrounding oneself with a healthy, high-frequency inner circle and curating one's environment to maintain peace and productivity (52:15 - 54:46).


Video Description & Timecodes:

The Connection Between Influence, Character & Wealth

In this insightful episode, Aisha Bedwei breaks down the real-world dynamics of scaling the professional ladder and building sustainable wealth.

Timestamps:

0:00 - Introduction
6:18 - Why Africans climb the career ladder slower
9:56 - What top firms look for in candidates: Character
17:48 - Why income does not equal wealth
25:17 - Solving the wealth gap: Influence & Fluency
38:38 - The power of a growth mindset
45:47 - Selecting your support system
1:02:28 - Becoming the person you want to be
