videos.title: The Prosperity You Keep Praying For, What Do You Want to Do With It? || Dr. Arome Osayi
videos.description:
WHAT DO YOU REALLY WANT TO DO WITH YOUR PROSPERITY? | APOSTLE AROME OSAYI

If God answers your prayer for prosperity, what will you do with the resources He places in your hands? Will your wealth become a way to satisfy every personal desire and display your status, or will it become an opportunity to serve others in the spirit of Jesus?

In this challenging teaching, Apostle Arome Osayi calls believers to examine their motives for seeking financial prosperity. He questions the desire for wealth that focuses only on luxury, possessions, and outward displays of success. His message shifts attention from how much a person can acquire to how faithfully that person uses what they have.

**WHAT IS THE PURPOSE OF THE PROSPERITY YOU DESIRE?**

Many people pray for financial increase, greater opportunities, and the ability to afford the things they desire. But an important question often remains: what is the purpose of that increase?

Apostle Arome Osayi challenges believers to look beyond expensive cars, personal comfort, and the desire to impress others. Prosperity should not be reduced to a status symbol or a means of satisfying every appetite. It should also prompt believers to consider how their resources can be used to serve God's purposes and meet the needs of others.

This teaching encourages you to examine your intentions. Are you seeking more because you want to display your success, or are you prepared to use greater resources with wisdom, generosity, and responsibility?

THE SPIRIT OF JESUS IS EXPRESSED THROUGH SELFLESS SERVICE

One of the central challenges in this message is the question of what you have done for which you expected no human reward or personal benefit.

Genuine service is not always accompanied by applause, recognition, repayment, or public appreciation. Sometimes, it means meeting a need simply because it is the right thing to do. It means giving without manipulating others into owing you a favour and helping without making recognition the condition for your generosity.

The example of Jesus points believers towards a life that values service above self promotion. This does not mean that every act of generosity must remain private, but it challenges the motive behind our giving and our willingness to help when no reward is guaranteed.

ROYAL PROSPERITY AND KINGDOM RESPONSIBILITY

Apostle Arome Osayi uses the expression “Royal Prosperity” while encouraging believers to continue in a pattern of service that reflects the spirit of Jesus.

The challenge is to develop a different understanding of prosperity. Instead of measuring success only by what you own, consider how your resources contribute to the wellbeing of others. Your money, opportunities, skills, and influence can all become ways to serve, support meaningful work, and respond to genuine needs.

The more you have, the more opportunities you may have to make a difference. The important question is whether your priorities reflect the responsibility that comes with what you have received.

KEY LESSONS FROM THIS MESSAGE

1. Examine your motives before pursuing greater financial prosperity.
2. Do not reduce wealth to luxury, status, or the approval of others.
3. Practise generosity without making personal rewards the reason for giving.
4. Use your resources to serve others and respond to genuine needs.
5. Let the example of Jesus shape your attitude towards wealth and service.
6. Consider not only what you want to receive, but what you are willing to contribute.
7. Make service and faithful stewardship part of your understanding of prosperity.

**A QUESTION FOR YOU**

What have you done for someone simply to help, without expecting a reward, recognition, or favour in return?

This teaching by Apostle Arome Osayi invites you to rethink your prayers for prosperity and consider the purpose behind your financial ambitions. The goal is not merely to have more, but to become more faithful and intentional in how you use what you have.

Watch this Short, reflect on the message, and share it with someone who wants to understand prosperity from a kingdom perspective. Subscribe to Apostle Arome Osayi for more teachings on biblical prosperity, stewardship, Christian living, and spiritual growth.

videos.title: Standing Strong No Matter What You Are Going Through | Joyce Meyer
videos.description:
Joyce Meyer preaches a powerful full sermon on faith, encouragement, and trusting God with the impossible in "All Things Are Possible." Drawing from Scripture including Luke 5, Luke 19, Mark 10, and Matthew 19, Joyce breaks down what it really means to partner with God through faith and patience, why so many people give up in "the middle" of their breakthrough, and how stories like Zacchaeus, Bartimaeus, and Lazarus reveal a God who responds to bold, active faith rather than passive waiting. She shares personal testimonies about stirring up faith after decades in ministry, staying amazed at what God is doing, and refusing to let fear, comparison, or discouragement steal the promises God has for your life.

This message is for anyone feeling stuck, discouraged, or unsure if their prayers are being heard, offering practical steps to release faith through prayer, spoken confession, and action rather than just waiting for a miracle to fall from the sky. Joyce also answers real viewer questions about persevering through cancer, praying for loved ones who seem to resist God, staying positive amid bad news, and understanding how faith and patience work together according to Mark 11 and Hebrews. Watch the full teaching for biblical encouragement on healing, forgiveness, salvation, and living boldly by faith with Joyce Meyer and Enjoying Everyday Life.

Joyce Meyer, one of the world’s leading practical Bible teachers and New York Times best-selling author, shares encouragement and advice to help us enjoy our daily lives.

With a heart to share Christ and love people, Joyce’s messages help people in all walks of life to grow in their faith, learn to study the Bible, find healing from the wounds of life, get answers to life’s questions and encounter the love of God in a powerful way.
